paite: Huai khit in Toupa'n midang sawmsagih asep a, apaina ding kho teng leh mun teng ah, ama ah nihnih in asawl hi.
heading: Nungzui Sawmsagihte Sawlkhiakna / (Luk 9.3-5; Mat 11.22-23,25-27; 13.16-17)
english: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.

paite: Akiang uah, "Buh lak ding atam mahmah a, himahleh asemte atawm uh, huchi in abuh la ding a sem dingte sawl ding in buh neipa kiang ah ngen un.
english: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

paite: Pai un; ngai un, ngehon lak a belamnou bang in ka hon sawl ahi.
english: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

paite: Dangka ip, kawlzal leh khedap tawi kei unla, lampi ah kuamah chibai buk kei un.
english: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

paite: Huan inn na lutna peuh uah amasapen in, 'Hiai inn ah khamuanna tung hen!' chi un.
english: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

paite: Huai inn a khamuanna ta a-omleh na khamuanna thu uh atung ah a-om ding a; a-om keileh na kiang uah ahong kik nawn ding hi.
english: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

paite: Huai inn ah tung in om nilouh unla, ahon piak peuh uh ne in dawn un; nasemmi loh mu tak ahi. Inn teng ah ban hoh kei un.
english: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.

paite: Huan khua na lutna peuh uah hon kipahpih uleh, hon lui peuh uh na ne ding ua; huai a damlou omte leng na hihdam ding ua;
english: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

paite: akiang uah, 'Pathian lalgam na kiang uah hong tungta,' na chi ding uh.
english: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

paite: Khua na lutna peuh uah hon kipahpih kei uleh akongzing uah paikhia unla,
english: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,

paite: na kho leivui uh ka khepek ua bang teng na tung uah tatsiang ung e; himahleh Pathian lalgam ahong naita chih thei un, na chi ding uhi.
english: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

paite: K'on hilh ahi, huai ni chiang in huai khuate thuak sang in Sodom khua thuak ding adan a-om zaw ding hi.
english: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

paite: "Korazin, na tung agik e! Bethsaida, na tung agik e! Noumau a thillamdang kihihte Tura leh Sidon a hih hileh, sai-ip puan silh a vut lak a tu in akisik khin thamta ding uh.
heading: Kisik Nuam Lou Khopite / (Mat 11.20-24)
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

paite: Himahleh thukhen ni chiang in nou thuak sang in Tura leh Sidon khua thuak ding adan a-om zaw ding.
english: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

paite: Huan nang Kapernaum, van tan ah tawisang in na om a, misikhua a sawnkhiak a om ding na hi.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.

paite: "Kuapeuh na thu uh ngaikhia keimah thu ngaikhia ahi a; kuapeuh nou hon deih lou kei hon deih lou ahi; kuapeuh nou hon ngai lou kei hon ngai lou ahi a, kuapeuh kei hon ngai lou tuh hon sawlpa ngai lou ahi," achi hi.
english: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”

paite: Huan sawmsagihte kipaktak in ahong kik nawn ua, "Toupa, dawite nangawn na min ziak in ka thuthu un a-om uh," achi uhi.
heading: Sawmsagihte Kik Nawnna
english: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Khophia bang in van a kipan Setan hong kia ka mu hi.
english: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

paite: Ngai un, gulte, aikamte sikdenna thu leh melma thilhihtheihna tengteng tung a thuneihna ka hon pia ahi; bangmah in ahon hih na kei hial ding.
english: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

paite: Himahleh dawite na thuthu ua a-om ziak un kipak kei un; van a na min uh gelh ahih ziak in kipak zaw un,” achi hi.
english: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

paite: Huai laitak in Jesu, Kha Siangthou in akipak mahmah a, "Pa aw, lei leh van Toupa, nang mipil leh mibengvakte kiang ah hiai thu na iim a, naungekte kiang a na than ziak in ka hon phat hi; ahi, Pa, huchibang hih nang ngaih in ahoih ahi.
heading: Jesu Kipahthu Genna / (Mat 11.25-27; 13.16-17)
english: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”

paite: Ka Pa'n bangkim ahon kemsak a, Tapa kua ahia, Pa lou ngal kuamah in athei kei, Pa leng kua ahia, Tapa leh akiang ua Tapa in atheihsak nopnate kia lou ngal kuamah in athei kei," achi hi.
english: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

paite: Huan nungzuite lam anga a, asim in, "Na thil muhte uh amu mitte ahampha e!
english: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

paite: K'on chi ahi, zawlnei tampi leh kumpipa tampite'n leng na thil muhte uh muh akilawp gige ua, himahleh amu kei uh, bil a na zakte uh leng zak akilawp thei mahmah ua, himahleh aza kei uh," achi hi.
english: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”

paite: Huan ngai un dan thei mi kuahiam adingh a, amah ze-etna ding in, "Sinsakpa, tangtawn hinna neihna ding in bang ka hih dia?" achi hi.
heading: Samari Mihoih Gentehna
english: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Dan laibu ah bang gelh ahia? Bangchi in na sim a?" achi hi.
english: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Toupa, na Pathian na lungtang tengteng, na kha tengteng, na hatna tengteng, na lungsim tengteng in na it ding ahi; nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding ahi, chih," chi in adawng hi.
english: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang ah, "Na dawng dik hi; huchi in hih lechin na hing ding,” achi hi.
english: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”

paite: Ama'n bel kisiamtansak ut in, Jesu kiang ah, "Ahihleh, ka inveng kua ahia?" achi hi.
english: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, "Kuahiam Jerusalem a kipan Jeriko ah ahohsuk a, suamhatte atuak hi. Amau apuansilh asuahsak vek ua, avua ua, si dektak in apaisanta uhi.
english: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

paite: Huan huai lampi ah siampu kuahiam ava paisuk a, amuhtak in lampi sik lehlam ah apel maimah hi.
english: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

paite: Huan huchibang mah in Levi chimi khat leng huai mun ahong tung a, amuhtak in lampi sik lehlam ah apel maimah hi.
english: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

paite: Himahleh, Samaria gam a mi kuahiam zin pai lai a-omna ahong tung a, amuhtak in alainat mahmah hi.
english: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

paite: Akiang ah ava hoh a, aliamnate thau leh uain abuak a, atuam a, amah gan tung ah atuangsak a, khualbuk ah apaipih a, akemta hi.
english: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

paite: Huan azing in makhai nih asuahkhia a, khualbuk kempa kiang ah apia a, amah na kem inla, hiai ban ana zat teng, ka hong kik nawn chiang in ka hon din ding," achi hi.
english: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’

paite: Huai mi thumte lak ah, suamhatte tuakpa a ding in, invengte hi pen kua hi in na gingta a? achi hi.
english: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”

paite: Ama'n, "Huai atung a zahngaihna suahpa," achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Nang leng huai mah bang in va hih in," achi hi.
english: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

paite: Huan azin kawm un khua khat ah alut a; numei khat amin Martha in ana zintun hi.
heading: Martha Leh Mari
english: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

paite: Huai minu'n sanggam numei khat anei a, amin Mari ahi, huai minu Toupa khebul ah atu a, athu angaikhia hi.
english: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.

paite: Martha in bel nna sem in abuai mahmah a; huchi in akiang a hong pai in, "Toupa, ka sanggamnu'n kei kia nasem ding a hon khiat khawk sa lou na hi maw? Hon huh ding in sawl in,” achi hi.
english: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”

paite: Toupa'n, "Martha, Martha, thil tampi na ngaihtuah a, buai nei ve; thil khat kia akul ahi;
english: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

paite: Mari in tan hoih atel a, huai laksak ding ahi kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
